components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, 0px border-radius (sharp corners), no shadow. Hover: slight lift and shadow-sm.
components.buttons: Sharp corners, high contrast. Primary buttons use International Klein Blue. Padding: px-6 py-2.
components.tables: Dense rows, 1px bottom borders, hover states on rows. Header rows use overline label typography (uppercase, tracked out).
components.navigation: Sidebar for dashboard with 1px right border. Solid background, active states marked by 2px left border in Primary color.
components.forms: Inputs should have sharp borders. Use Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox but override radii to 0. Focus rings must be tight and use Primary Blue.

layout_spacing.padding_internal: p-4 md:p-6 for cards and sections
layout_spacing.alignment: Left-align all data and labels for quick scanning. Right-align numerical values in tables.

motion.hover: Instant background color shifts, no slow fades. It must feel like a tactical terminal.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Regular or Bold weight, technical precision.

image_urls.description: Sleek WiFi 6 router on wooden desk. Use as a half-page image on the login screen with a subtle blue tint overlay.
High-tech server rack in a secure data center. Use with low opacity (10%) as a subtle background for the AI diagnostics panel or empty states.

page_specific_instructions.login_page: Split layout. Left: Crisp form with 'Chivo' headings. Right: Hero image (WiFi 6 router) with a subtle blue tint overlay.
page_specific_instructions.super_admin_dashboard: Control room grid. Top row: 4 KPI summary cards (col-span-1). Middle row: Main bandwidth/traffic chart (col-span-3) + active alerts list (col-span-1).
page_specific_instructions.device_detail_page: Bento layout. Left column (col-span-8): WAN/WiFi Config Editor (forms). Right column (col-span-4): Real-time Status, AI Diagnostics toggle, and Speed Test mini-panel.
page_specific_instructions.ai_diagnostics_panel: Use JetBrains Mono for the terminal-style output of Gemini 3 Flash. Highlight issues in Signal Red and suggestions in Warning Yellow or Primary Blue. Give it a slightly darker background (10% grey) to separate from the main UI.
page_specific_instructions.global_settings: Forms must use Shadcn components heavily modified for sharp corners. AI toggle should be a crisp square switch, not a rounded pill.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratios. Do not use pure gray; tint grays slightly with blue (#F1F3F5).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='ai-toggle-switch').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (grid borders), avoid wrapping everything in Shadcn 'Card' components to maintain the raw technical look.
Use Shadcn for complex interactions (Tables, Dropdowns, Dialogs, Select).
Update tailwind.config.js to set border-radius values to 0px for a sharp, brutalist tech feel.
Add 'Chivo', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' to google fonts import in index.css and map them in tailwind.config.js.
Follow the 'Control Room Grid' for dashboard pages. All grid items must be direct children.
Do NOT center align text in dense areas; always left-align for scanning.
In index.css, update CSS variables: --primary to the designated blue (hsl 223 100% 33%), --radius to 0rem.
Ensure the application strictly follows the light theme, modifying the root CSS variables in index.css to match the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype.
